title: Maximum Collinear Points
statement: Given n integer points, find the maximum number that lie on one straight line. reference_python:
import sys,math,collections;a=list(map(int,sys.stdin.read().split()));n=a[0];p=[(a[1+2*i],a[2+2*i]) for i in range(n)];ans=1
for i in range(n):
 c=collections.Counter();dup=0;best=0
 for j in range(i+1,n):
  dx=p[j][0]-p[i][0];dy=p[j][1]-p[i][1]
  if dx==dy==0:dup+=1;continue
  g=math.gcd(dx,dy);dx//=g;dy//=g
  if dx<0 or dx==0 and dy<0:dx=-dx;dy=-dy
  c[(dx,dy)]+=1;best=max(best,c[(dx,dy)])
 ans=max(ans,best+dup+1)
print(ans)
intended_complexity: O(n^2 log C) time, O(n) extra space
